title: ZCCM-IH posts K4.92bn loss for 2025 as Mopani, KCM drag earnings
summary: ZCCM Investments Holdings recorded a ZMW4.92 billion (US$261.7m) loss in 2025, driven by the absence of the 2024 Mopani strategic-equity-partner gain and ongoing underperformance at Mopani and Konkola Copper Mines. The holding company owns 49% of Mopani and 20.6% of KCM; recovery now hinges on operating reforms and restarting production at both assets.

title: Zambia fuel prices unchanged for September 2026
summary: The Energy Regulation Board kept national pump prices flat for September 2026: petrol K25.29/litre, diesel K26.86, kerosene K27.02 and Jet A-1 K28.71. Stability persisted despite pressure from international oil prices and the exchange rate, giving households and businesses another month of fuel-cost certainty.

title: Zambia H1 2026 energy investment tops US$1bn; new rules for generators
summary: African Energy reports that energy-sector investment in Zambia topped US$1 billion in H1 2026, accompanied by new regulatory rules for embedded generators. Separately, a South African developer acquired a major wind IPP, underscoring continued private capital inflows into Zambia's power sector.

title: Zambia sets five-year economic focus on investment, production, exports and jobs
summary: Government unveiled a five-year economic strategy centred on investment, production, exports and job creation. Mining remains a key source of activity and export earnings, while reliable energy supply is flagged as critical to enabling businesses to operate and expand.

title: ZRA suspends customs duty on specified wheat imports for September 2026
summary: The Zambia Revenue Authority announced a temporary suspension of customs duty on specified wheat imports effective 1–30 September 2026, covering a combined 300,000 tonnes of approved imports. The measure aims to steady domestic supply and food prices.

title: Airtel, MTN sued for K10 billion over alleged pyramid scheme
summary: Airtel Zambia and MTN Zambia face a K10 billion lawsuit in the Lusaka High Court from more than 300 investors seeking compensation for losses allegedly linked to a nationwide pyramid scheme. The claim also names the ICT regulator, ZICTA.

title: AfDB Country Focus Report 2026: mobilising Zambia's development financing
summary: The African Development Bank's Country Focus Report 2026 on Zambia notes real GDP rebounded to 5.2% in 2025 (from 3.8% in 2024), driven by agriculture, ICT, manufacturing and mining, with net exports and FDI the main demand-side drivers. Growth is projected around 5.0%, with the report focused on scaling up development financing in a fragmented global environment.

title: Bank of Zambia official USD/ZMW ~K19.63 as kwacha softens further
summary: BoZ-published exchange-rate data for 18 September 2026 put the official rate near K19.625/USD (CNY ~K2.9312), with exchange-rate trackers showing the USD/ZMW high for the week at ~K19.63 on 16 Sep. The kwacha has continued to soften through mid-September on seasonal import and end-of-quarter FX demand.
